title: Clothes flashcards (garments only) and sentence frames
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Common vocabulary: numbers, colours, clothes and shapes
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 15 (Clothes flashcards (garments only) and sentence frames (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 15: Clothes: naming and describing with a colour. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: I wear
points: أَلْبَسُ قَمِيصًا (albasu qamisan): I wear a shirt
After أَلْبَسُ: the item ends in -an

model.title: I wear a white thobe on Friday.

parts.text: أَبْيَضَ (white, masculine, object form, no tanwin)

panels.title: My clothes are ...
points: قَمِيصِي أَزْرَقُ: my shirt is blue
حِذَائِي أَسْوَدُ: my shoes are black
قُبَّعَتِي حَمْرَاءُ: my cap is red (feminine)

blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.

parts.text: أَلْبَسُ. مِعْطَفًا (object). Black masculine, object form: أَسْوَدَ.

questions.q: Say: I wear a black coat.
Core: Write four sentences about what you wear for school and for the masjid (portal response box), with colours.
questions.a: For example: أَلْبَسُ قَمِيصًا أَبْيَضَ. أَلْبَسُ سِرْوَالًا أَسْوَدَ. أَلْبَسُ ثَوْبًا أَبْيَضَ لِلْمَسْجِدِ. أَلْبَسُ حِذَاءً أَسْوَدَ.

questions.q: Extend: Write what you wear in winter: فِي الشِّتَاءِ أَلْبَسُ ...
questions.a: For example: فِي الشِّتَاءِ أَلْبَسُ مِعْطَفًا وَقُبَّعَةً.

questions.q: Stretch: Describe one feminine item with a colour, e.g. a hat or a scarf.
questions.a: For example: أَلْبَسُ قُبَّعَةً زَرْقَاءَ. / قُبَّعَتِي زَرْقَاءُ.
A) I wear a coat. أَلْبَسُ = I wear; مِعْطَفًا = a coat.

questions.q: What is قَمِيص? A) shirt B) coat C) shoe
Big question: describe what you are wearing now in one Arabic sentence.
